name: Monday Night Massacre

date.source: The card's own dateline reads "Date TBD" — the fed never set one, and no results page for it survives. The document itself was captured 2 December 2002.

no_appearances_reason: The card bills one match and names nobody in it: "All wrestlers will participate in an over-the-top-rope battle royal." With no entrant named, there is no billing to receipt as an appearance (THE BILLED APPEARANCE requires a primary source billing a specific entity), and no results page for the show survives anywhere in the account's own capture record.
notes: A held card with no date and no result — the fed's own "Recent MNM Results" and "Card Archive" pages, both linked from its home page, have no capture in any pipeline and are treated as lost. The battle royal was to settle two things at once: last man over the top rope becomes the number-one contender, last man left in the ring is crowned Television Champion.
